lede: The biggest item this week is the San Miguel County BOCC meeting on August 5th, where commissioners will hold public hearings on three Land Use Code amendments — including changes to how 'Qualified Owner' is defined, a wildfire areas update, and a continued hearing on nonconforming lots. Also on the 5th, the Ouray County Planning Commission meets virtually to work through possible changes to their Land Use Code definitions section, which is exactly the kind of quiet rewrite that shapes everything downstream. The week opens with the San Miguel Basin Fair and Rodeo, the New York Philharmonic Brass Quintet, and a free Jungle Book show at the Sheridan.
